controls.evidence: Production settings require RBAC and PostgreSQL and reject legacy API-key authentication and disabled auth.

controls.control: Session cookie confidentiality and cross-site policy
controls.evidence: Session cookies are HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure in production, bounded by a configurable TTL and deleted on logout.
Session write/admin requests require the persisted CSRF token; the frontend reads only the non-HttpOnly CSRF cookie and sends X-CSRF-Token.

controls.control: Personal Token hashing, expiry and revocation
controls.evidence: Only SHA-256 token hashes are persisted; expiry, revocation, user disable and password reset invalidate access, and old secrets cannot be reused.

controls.control: Password verification and login abuse resistance
controls.evidence: Passwords use scrypt-v1, unknown users receive dummy verification work, failed credentials increment lockout state, and responses remain generic.
Live user roles cap token scopes; ADMIN cannot mutate OWNER, last OWNER protection is enforced, and unauthenticated/under-scoped requests return 401/403.
The browser uses same-origin cookies, never localStorage or legacy API-key headers, and sends CSRF only for non-read methods.

controls.control: Audit and request correlation on security-sensitive API writes
controls.evidence: API requests receive request/trace IDs and non-read API operations write actor, resource and status to the audit stream.
